comment: dig.c rot_corpse() 2166-2169: a cockatrice corpse rots away while a monster wields it, so rot_corpse() unwields it with setmnotwielded() (2169). A debug Valkyrie puts on wished leather gloves, wishes for a cockatrice corpse and drops it beside a tame djinni; the djinni (stone resistant, so select_hwep() ranks the corpse first) picks it up and wields it, and she searches in counts of 20 until the corpse's ROT_CORPSE timer fires near turn 500.
